text: Okay so I finally sat down and read the full patch notes for 2.4 and I have thoughts. The inventory rework is mostly good: stacking consumables to 99 was overdue, and the new sort-by-rarity filter actually works, unlike the one in 2.1 that reset every time you opened a chest. The crafting changes are more mixed. Moving the legendary recipes behind the reputation grind with the Iron Covenant means anyone who skipped that faction has roughly 12 hours of fetch quests before they can craft endgame gear, which is a weird choice for a patch that is supposed to be about respecting player time. Combat-wise the parry window went from 12 frames to 9, and you can feel it; the mid-game bosses are noticeably harder, especially the twin sentinels in the Sunken Vault, where the second sentinel's overhead used to be trivially parried and now needs a dodge instead. I like the direction but the transition could have been smoother, maybe a training dummy that shows the new timing. Economy: vendor prices dropped about 15 percent across the board, gold income from dungeons dropped about 20, so it is a net nerf even though the notes frame it as a buff. The new zone, the Ashen Reach, is gorgeous. The lighting when the ash storms roll in is some of the best environmental work in the game, and the ambient audio of the wind through the ruined towers is genuinely unsettling in a good way. The zone's story quest has one pacing problem: the third act sends you back to the capital for a single dialogue and then straight back, which is ten minutes of travel for thirty seconds of content. Multiplayer: the matchmaker now prefers similar gear score, which fixed most of the carry problem in random dungeons, but queue times for tanks went from two minutes to seven on my server. Performance is better on my 3070, I went from dips to 45 in the capital to a stable 60, and shader compilation on first launch took under two minutes. Overall a 7 out of 10 patch: strong content, questionable economy tuning, and one grind that should not be there. Curious what everyone else thinks, especially people who main healer, since the mana regen change did not get mentioned anywhere.
